        "Read all43 eligible owned paths and4716 exact diff lines, including removed Folder/nsIFolder interfaces, IDL/build metadata, complete new native database implementation and every changed test hunk. Actual NUL paths checked. No Suite-only paths or conditional bodies are used. This is a human-authored architecture change, not an automated commit, formatter-only change, backout or3171 cast repair.",
        "The patch removes cached XPCom Folder objects and getFolderById/getFolderForMsgFolder. FolderDatabase becomes a numeric-ID API;0 is missing lookup and the root-list sentinel only where specified. nsIMsgFolder.id/initWithFolderId bridge the legacy object boundary. Message.accountKey walks root/name to incoming server/account; Message.folder and VirtualFolderWrapper translate numeric IDs with getMsgFolderForFolder. FolderInfo stores its parent database folder ID and flags/count/property calls use it. These do not establish every legacy method is implemented or a production migration is complete.",
        "Duplicate insertRoot/insertFolder changes from returning an existing object to SQL uniqueness failure. CreateNewDB explicitly looks up and inserts only when0. The historical JS incoming-server getter still used ?? after getFolderChildNamed; a missing row returns numeric0, so insertRoot is skipped. Accepted current source uses ||; POP3 extends MsgIncomingServer and nondeferred rootMsgFolder uses the inherited getter. This is a statically checked old/current contract difference, not a fresh reproduced regression or a blanket preference for || over ??. C++ CreateRootFolder retains a separate inherited InsertRoot return value not assigned to rv; no new-regression or runtime-error conclusion is inferred.",
        "Folder existence/identity resides in SQL; the private row cache stores parent/name/ordinal/flags, not the former full hierarchy/path maps. Relationships query rows and descendants traverse depth-first with sorted siblings. Path construction walks current parent names, so moved descendant lookups follow new ancestry. Reuse existing path/Unicode/move boundary notes instead of creating duplicate rules. Comparator ordinal/name/flag getter fallbacks do not establish row validity.",
        "Insertion normalizes names, child-name/path lookup normalizes comparisons and duplicate composed/decomposed insertion is directly asserted. Reconcile deletion still compares raw childNames against normalized stored names, explicitly TODO-normalizing its input. A decomposed-equivalent name is not proven to preserve an existing ID during reconciliation. Delete removes descendant rows/cache entries; messages unlink remains TODO, so no message cleanup guarantee.",
        "Only slash characters are encoded by getFolderPath while getFolderByPath uses general percent decoding. Active tests assert slash encoding, missing0, case-sensitive paths and NFC-equivalent name lookup. Literal I%2FO examples are commented out with a TODO, not tests that pass or even run. No lossless arbitrary-name roundtrip guarantee. Current same limits remain.",
        "IDL says getFolderChildren throws on a nonzero nonexistent parent, while inspected implementation queries WHERE parent=:id without an explicit existence lookup and can return an empty list. Ancestry predicates reject0 but only fetch the walked side; a nonzero comparison ID is not independently validated despite either-missing IDL wording. Direct relations tests cover valid IDs and0 ancestors, not these missing-ID promises. Treat this as a scoped documentation/implementation mismatch, not assume all methods reject every stale ID.",
        "Cache trim is provisional: a cache miss at/above512 discards128 arbitrary entries. Direct insertion puts without calling trim, so512 is not a strict cap and this is not LRU. EnsureFolderCached obtains lookupForAdd before TrimCache mutation and later add; a separately revision-paired HashMap dependency check is needed before claiming the exact native failure. Local Gecko HashTable documentation was inspected narrowly and prohibits intervening mutation; compatibility with this accepted comm revision is not assumed. No cache stress/performance or memory-safety experiment.",
        "Direct tests change deleted-folder parent/root reads to errors; bridge tests reject0/missing IDs; LiveView tests reject0/list-with0/empty lists and repeated initialization. The broadened /NS_ERROR_/ assertion does not prove exact binding-layer error identity. Flags test now writes all16 low-four-bit combinations instead of mainly exercising JavaScript bitwise operators. Move/sort tests check exact arrays/ordinals and invalid moves; test_findFolders toSorted checks membership without asserting that returned display order. Relations expected childIds fields are unused, including a self entry, so that table alone is not a child-list assertion. A disabled assertion block supplies no executed coverage.",
        "Manual review distinguishes useful reason/constraint comments from tentative design notes: database ownership, future reconciliation layers, bridge relocation and cache replacement are proposals or limits, not completed changes. initWithFolderId names the actual input, dbCore names the core-of-database receiver, and folderId/parentId distinguish numeric roles. The short p cache lookup variable remains accepted local code; reviewer criticism plus author defense is not a global short-name ban. IDL depth-first/sorted-siblings wording is adopted. The bare Do this? inline has no retained replacement expression, so no exact edit is invented. No blanket parameter-prefix, static-pref or macro-order rule.",
        "Changed-scope assertion check parsed150 executable changed JavaScript Assert calls using actual ok/equal/deepEqual/throws message argument positions and found124 missing messages.13 changed MOZ_ASSERT calls lack explicit messages; trailing comments are not messages. Exact paths/lines/snippets retained in3170-assertion-findings.json and attached to this row. This is the user-directed current message requirement, not a claim that historical missing should alone was a defect. A suitable changed scalar example is The missing folder path should return0. Native ownership/debugging motivates the redesign; visible performance gain was uncertain and is not claimed.",
        "D256594 complete creation-to-close timeline and all32 actual submitted current/outdated inline bodies read, with0 summary histories. Author explains deliberate duplicate-insert errors and private scalar cache, not retaining full folder graph in memory. Higher-level protocol-specific reconciliation is a proposed responsibility split; actual Reconcile still deletes absent nonvirtual children and retains raw-list NFC TODO. Bridge relocation and better concrete getter documentation remain desired follow-ups, not implemented ownership changes.",
        "Exact historical/current code confirms initWithFolderId input naming, dbCore receiver naming, changed native static preference reads, depth-first sorted-sibling IDL description and unwrapOr expression inside the log call. Short p cache pointer remains in exact code; reviewer criticizes it and author defends short names in a small scope. This is accepted local practice, not a global short-name ban, dbCore mandate, cast rule, parameter-prefix policy or instruction update. Comment indentation/wrapping/typo requests do not imply a formatter-wide convention. Bare Do this? inline1410268 has no retained replacement expression, so no code suggestion is invented.",
        "Lossless encoding was explicitly deferred in reviewer1410276 and author1411057: literal-percent names must be distinguished from slash-containing names eventually. Author intentionally leaves current encode/decode behavior and adds commented-out checks. Exact source proves that deferral; Done badges and later acceptance do not mean encoding was fixed. The active slash/NFC checks are distinct from disabled literal-percent examples.",
        "Author describes test_findFolders.toSorted as an initial assumption that null-ordinal ordering was undefined, then notes name sorting may define it. Actual assertions with toSorted prove membership, not returned display order; dedicated sort tests directly assert order. Flag rewrite directly writes16 combinations rather than mostly asserting JavaScript bitwise operations. Relations childIds table is not read by assertion loop. LiveView broad error regex does not establish exact script-boundary error identity. Automated remote-build events are retained historical status only; linked artifacts and Try jobs are unopened.",
        "All43 owned diff paths and every changed test hunk read; current comparisons bounded to numeric lookup/creation/bridge/cache and direct consumers. Existing focused lessons are linked for numeric-to-object bridge, removed-API docs, local C++ naming family, parent0/root, derived paths, NFC identity and active reparent/display-order guards. Added source findings include historical JS?? versus current|| for missing0, limited stale-ID validation versus IDL wording, raw-list reconciliation normalization TODO and changed assertion message omissions. No native crash, performance, migration completion, physical file move, message unlink, build, test or live accessibility result is invented. Separately revision-paired HashMap cache-lifetime validation remains a bounded source dependency, not a missing primary discussion."
